test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the FALSE statement in the context of digestion.

options.text: Assimilation comes before ingestion but after absorption.
Assimilation and absorption both occur before egestion.
Digestion comes before egestion but after ingestion.
Absorption comes before assimilation but after digestion.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Assimilation comes before ingestion but after absorption**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ingestion** is the first step in the digestive process, where food is taken into the body through the mouth.
 
• **Digestion** follows ingestion, where food is broken down into smaller, absorbable molecules through mechanical and chemical processes.
 
• **Absorption** occurs after digestion, where nutrients from the digested food are absorbed into the bloodstream through the walls of the small intestine.
 
• **Assimilation** happens after absorption, where the absorbed nutrients are utilized by the body's cells for energy, growth, and repair.
 
• **Egestion** is the final step, where undigested and unabsorbed waste materials are eliminated from the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Ingestion → Digestion → Absorption → Assimilation → Egestion** is the correct sequence.
 
• Assimilation cannot occur before ingestion because ingestion is the first step.
 
• Assimilation occurs after absorption, as the absorbed nutrients are transported to cells for use.
 
• Absorption occurs after digestion, as only digested food can be absorbed.
 
• Egestion is the last step, involving the removal of undigested waste.
